item.text:
**(a) Social posts**

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no one will be able to shut it down once it is running. We must face that reality before it’s too late.

2. We believe this plainly: build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, and once it’s running, no one will be able to shut it down. That’s why choices made now matter.

3. Once superintelligent AI is running, no one will be able to shut it down if it is built within the next 20 years. We must act with that reality in view.

**(b) Newsletter opening**

If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, no one will be able to shut it down once it is running. We hold this position with full conviction because the stakes are too high for comforting assumptions. The decisions made now—about research, investment, governance and public accountability—will shape what gets built and how quickly it moves from development into the world. We cannot treat shutdown as a reliable fallback or assume that control will arrive after deployment. We need to confront the consequences before systems of this kind are running, and make their development a matter of urgent public concern. We are committed to putting that reality at the center of the conversation.
